entries.note: Greek Ἰησοῦν is at verse end (πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν); BSB's leading 'said Jesus' [2] is a translator addition. Maps to [18].
Second Ἰησοῦς (i=22) = 'Jesus replied' -> [20]. Uses wordIndexes (array) form to exercise that branch.
Single Ἰησοῦς (i=14) = 'Jesus was walking ahead' -> [9]; BSB's later 'Again Jesus' [26] is a translator addition.
